rule: GOAL: Move the blue bar to block the beam’s path so it reflects or conducts energy to the target. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the bar’s horizontal position; Space fires the beam to test alignment. RULE: The beam only activates the target when it strikes the blue bar directly. TRAP: Believing the bar merely blocks the beam; it must intercept the path to conduct energy, not just sit nearby.

GOAL: Reach the exit tile using minimal moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the player in that direction. RULE: The player slides continuously until hitting a wall or another block. TRAP: Believing a single arrow press moves only one square, causing repeated inputs and wasted turns.

GOAL: Move the gray square into the blue circle at the end of the dotted path. CONTROLS: Click a dot on the path to jump the square to that spot. RULE: You can only jump to dots within three steps along the line. TRAP: Do not assume you can click distant targets; long-range clicks fail silently.

GOAL: Guide the yellow plug through the gray maze to reach the gate. CONTROLS: Left button moves the plug left; right button moves it right. RULE: The gray fluid shifts away from the plug’s path, creating a sliding tunnel. TRAP: Do not assume the gray is static; it expands into empty space as you move.

GOAL: Grow the green and yellow bars so their tips touch the matching plus signs. CONTROLS: Click the outer end of a bar to lengthen it; click the base to shorten it. RULE: Each click shifts the bar’s end by three spaces, requiring precise alignment with the target. TRAP: Assuming any overlap with the plus sign counts as success, rather than needing exact tip contact.

GOAL: Move the sliding plug rightward to reach the gate. CONTROLS: Click buttons above or below the wall to shift the plug left or right. RULE: The plug position and the gray barrier edge are locked in a mirror sum; they move in opposite directions. TRAP: Believing you can force the plug right when the gray barrier hits zero, ignoring that the shared constraint blocks further movement.

GOAL: Turn specific grid cells green to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selection cursor; clicks toggle cell colors. RULE: Only toggling a cell from white or gray to green costs steps; reverting to gray is free. TRAP: Believing all clicks consume the budget wastes time; undoing mistakes does not cost moves.

GOAL: Align the top bar pattern with the bottom socket to unlock the exit. CONTROLS: Clicking switches toggled bar colors; clicking the board rotated the plug. RULE: Match the checkerboard’s dark and light sequence exactly to the socket’s shape. TRAP: Assuming switches moved the plug directly; they only changed the pattern to fit.

GOAL: Shrink the oversized tip to fit the narrow neck. CONTROLS: Click white grid cells to match the yellow pattern; use arrows to move the tool. RULE: Completing the grid pattern halves the tip’s size, allowing it to pass through tight spaces. TRAP: Assuming rotation changes the tip’s total footprint; it only shifts internal parts, leaving the block too wide for the exit.

GOAL: Match pink shapes to targets by cycling through shape palettes. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor between slots; UP cycles the shape in the current slot. RULE: Each slot holds one shape from a fixed sequence; align the cursor to the target slot, then cycle until the shape matches the goal. TRAP: Assuming shapes appear in a predictable order; you must cycle until the exact shape identity appears, regardless of rotation.

GOAL: Fill the three frame slots with boxes to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move and turn; Space grabs or drops the attached box. RULE: A box stays in place only if dropped while the player faces it directly. TRAP: Assuming boxes lock instantly; they remain loose until the correct drop action is triggered.

GOAL: Clear the level by retracting beads to the base and piercing a target. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the beam tip; LEFT retracted, RIGHT extended, UP shifted the beam vertically. RULE: Beads stack against the base, limiting how far the tip can retract based on bead count. TRAP: Assuming the tip could retract further than the stacked beads allowed wasted time on invalid moves.

GOAL: Guide a growing snake to cover the target marker. CONTROLS: Click right to grow the selected color; click left to shrink it. RULE: The snake’s tip must land exactly on the center of the plus sign. TRAP: Assuming any overlap with the target works; only the tip counts.

GOAL: Defeat the guard by landing directly on its tile to clear the path to the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; pressing UP from below the guard jumps onto it. RULE: You can safely stomp enemies by jumping on them, but they kill you if they lunge into you. TRAP: Avoid approaching from the side, as a lateral lunge is fatal; only vertical stomps are safe.

GOAL: Align seven color blocks to match the pink target row. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; Up and Down rotate the block at the cursor. RULE: Blocks cycle through a fixed seven-color sequence, so you can rotate forward or backward to reach the target. TRAP: Assuming every slot cycles in the same order causes errors; verify each block’s position individually rather than relying on a global pattern.

GOAL: Align three colored plugs with their gates by balancing fluid levels across connected regions. CONTROLS: Click buttons on region borders to transfer fluid from one side to the other. RULE: Each click moves fluid only if the source has capacity and the destination has space. TRAP: Believing that partial transfers are possible; clicks are all-or-nothing, so misjudging capacity causes wasted moves.

GOAL: Decode yellow glyphs into blue codes using a fixed dictionary, then set the blue row to match the hidden target sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and cycle values; confirm changes by moving right to lock the slot. RULE: Each yellow glyph maps to a specific blue code; unique segmentation ensures one correct translation path. TRAP: Assuming yellow values directly equal blue codes ignores the dictionary, causing immediate mismatch and wasted cycles.

GOAL: Combine two separated entities into one to deliver the result. CONTROLS: Click to move a piece toward the cursor, or click a spot to merge nearby pieces. RULE: Pieces only merge when close enough, so position them precisely before combining. TRAP: Assuming you can merge from far away wastes moves; you must first bring pieces within range.

GOAL: Align the tip to face the pink socket through the narrow neck. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; hitting a wall rotates it in place. RULE: A blocked push rotates the tip 90 degrees instead of moving. TRAP: Thinking blocked moves do nothing wastes turns; they are essential for rotation.

GOAL: Arrange colored blocks in the middle row to match the sequence shown in the top row. CONTROLS: Click a color in the bottom palette to select it, then click a slot in the middle row to place it. RULE: Placing a color swaps it with the gray block in that slot, moving the gray to the palette position. TRAP: Believing the top row was a source to drag from, rather than a static pattern to replicate.

GOAL: Align seven rotating tiles to match a hidden color pattern. CONTROLS: Arrow keys cycle the selected tile through its shape palette. RULE: Each tile cycles through a fixed sequence of shapes, not just colors. TRAP: Assuming tiles reset to start positions wastes moves; track exact cycle phases instead.

GOAL: Navigate the sliding maze to reach the exit within sixteen moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one tile at a time. RULE: The grid dimensions are fixed regardless of your character's position. TRAP: Assuming the bounding box shifts with your movement causes errors.

GOAL: Position each cross so its arms cover all four dots of its matching color. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected cross three cells. Space switches control between crosses. RULE: Crosses must align perfectly with dot intersections; movement steps are fixed at three cells. TRAP: Assuming charcoal boxes block movement wastes time; crosses pass through them freely.

GOAL: Position the moving nodes so the line's midpoint lands exactly on the target ring. CONTROLS: Click any open spot to move the nearest node there instantly. RULE: The level clears only when the calculated midpoint of the two endpoints aligns perfectly with the ring. TRAP: Assuming any position near the ring works; precise symmetry is required, as off-center placements fail.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to align the single yellow block with the marked bracket. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate the ring clockwise or counter-clockwise. RULE: The yellow block is the unique target; ignore other colors. TRAP: Wasting time on no-op clicks or analyzing bar mechanics instead of rotating to the goal.

GOAL: Navigate a path to the target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move the character one step. RULE: Walls block movement; open space allows passage. TRAP: Assuming black areas are solid when they may be walkable.

GOAL: Make the target grid's outer blocks match the color pattern shown in its center. CONTROLS: Click a block to toggle its color between red and blue. RULE: The center pattern dictates the required colors: white means red, green means blue. TRAP: Thinking you must adjust the reference grids; only the active target grid needs changes.

GOAL: Match the outer blocks to the center pattern, requiring the right-middle block to be red, not just the left column. CONTROLS: Clicking a block in the bottom-right panel toggles its color between blue and red. RULE: The center grid acts as the template; outer blocks must exactly replicate the center’s color arrangement to win. TRAP: Assuming only the left column needed fixing; ignoring the right-middle block’s requirement wasted time and actions.

GOAL: Move the orange cross and blue plus to cover their matching colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space cycles selection between shapes. RULE: Only the active shape moves; each arrow press shifts it three units. TRAP: Dark red dots are decoys; the diamond is an obstacle, not a target.

GOAL: Slide the green block into the empty frame slot. CONTROLS: Click a block to control it; arrow keys slide it until it hits a wall or frame. RULE: Blocks stop immediately when touching a frame edge, locking into place. TRAP: Thinking blocks pass through frame lines; they actually stop on contact, so aim precisely.

GOAL: Align both yellow pieces with their matching brackets using minimal moves. CONTROLS: Rotate the central ring or shift individual horizontal rows independently. RULE: Pieces only move when shifted into the active ring or rotated within it. TRAP: Assuming you can rotate a piece while it is parked in an outer row; you must return it to the ring first.

GOAL: Clear the board by jumping over pegs until only two remain. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click the landing spot to jump over an adjacent peg into an empty space. RULE: A jump is only legal if the peg immediately next to your selection is occupied and the spot directly beyond it is empty. TRAP: Assuming the vertical column aligns with the horizontal row’s grid index; it actually starts one column further right, shifting all vertical coordinates.

GOAL: Guide three shapes to their matching target dots using a shared sliding line. CONTROLS: Arrows move the line’s handle; Space cycles focus between shapes. RULE: Shapes only shift when the line touches them, requiring precise alignment. TRAP: Assuming shapes move independently; they are locked to the line’s path, forcing sequential positioning.

GOAL: Place the yellow block in the yellow bracket and the orange block in the orange bracket to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click the red and green arrows at the bottom to rotate the circular tracks and move blocks into position. RULE: Blocks only fit into brackets of the matching color, requiring specific rotations to align each piece correctly. TRAP: Assuming all brackets are interchangeable wastes moves; ignoring the color constraint prevents proper placement.

GOAL: Move the blocks to the spiral’s outer ends. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift blocks one cell per press. RULE: Blocks must follow the spiral path to the exit notches. TRAP: Believing blocks slide until hitting walls; they actually stop after one step.

GOAL: Solve the color rotation puzzle by aligning the columns and rows correctly. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate specific columns or rows forward or backward. RULE: Vertical cycles connect two columns into one long loop; bottom wraps to top of the other. TRAP: Assuming columns rotate independently instead of linking together causes mismatched colors.

GOAL: Paint the grid so the pattern group is one color and the background group is another. CONTROLS: Click a square to cycle its color between red and orange. RULE: Every square in a group must match; the two groups must differ. TRAP: Thinking the pattern's dot color dictates the solution; it is decorative, so any two distinct colors work.

GOAL: Guide two blocks to swap positions using only safe paths. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously in that direction. RULE: Blocks die instantly if they enter hazard zones; walls simply stop movement. TRAP: Assuming hazards are solid walls that block motion, rather than deadly traps that reset progress.

GOAL: Match each colored tile to its specific hidden slot to fill the frames. CONTROLS: Click two tiles to swap them; press space to check the result. RULE: A frame fills only if its color sits in its exact expected position. TRAP: Assuming a color is correct if it appears anywhere on the board wastes moves.

ESTABLISHED: The blue block starts at the top left. The red blob is stuck in a central pipe structure. Pressing keys moves the blue block. The blob only shifts slightly when pushed from above or below, then snaps back. FAILED: Approaching from the sides is impossible due to white walls. Pushing the blob from above or below does not free it. Spacebar teleports the blue block to the start and swaps HUD icons, but does not move the blob. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pushing the blob out of the pipe with the blue block. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the blue block. Spacebar resets the player position and toggl

GOAL: Place seven letters into slots, treating nested colored boxes as single units in a specific reading order. CONTROLS: Click a letter from the bottom palette, then click a target slot; press space to submit your arrangement. RULE: Follow the path: top-left, insert green box, top-middle, insert blue box, top-right. TRAP: Assuming all top-row slots are independent; ignoring that colored boxes occupy specific top-row positions breaks the sequence.

GOAL: Fill seven path slots using six movable pieces to match a target sequence. CONTROLS: Click to drag pieces from the palette to empty slots. Press space to check your progress. RULE: The path flows through red boxes, then green, then red again; the pre-filled piece marks the exact insertion point. TRAP: Assuming every visible slot is a valid target wastes moves; one slot is a decoy that must remain empty.

GOAL: Match cell colors to the hidden rule by cycling each tile through blue, red, and orange until the pattern aligns. CONTROLS: Click a tile to advance its color state; click again to cycle to the next hue in the sequence. RULE: White tiles take the dot’s color, while gray tiles take the opposite color, creating a strict two-tone contrast. TRAP: Assuming a simple two-color toggle wastes clicks; the cycle is actually three steps, so skipping ahead requires two precise clicks.

GOAL: Place three nodes to form a diamond square footprint that avoids water tiles. CONTROLS: Click nodes to select, drag to move, and click empty spaces to swap positions. RULE: Only the diamond-shaped footprint matters; water in the outer box corners is allowed. TRAP: Checking the full square box for water causes false rejections of valid center positions.

GOAL: Move two yellow blocks to specific top-row target slots. CONTROLS: Click a red button to rotate a large loop of blocks; click another to rotate a small loop. RULE: The large loop contains all blocks except the five in the small loop, so large rotations move the yellows without disturbing the small loop’s fixed positions. TRAP: Assuming the large loop excludes the corner cells; it actually includes them, requiring precise counting of rotation steps rather than assuming simple edge movement.

GOAL: Guide the blue block to the exit by using a ghost copy to clear the path. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; Space switches between recording your moves and watching the ghost replay them. RULE: The ghost repeats your previous moves exactly, allowing you to place obstacles before moving yourself. TRAP: Assuming the ghost persists after the recording ends; it only acts during the playback window.

GOAL: Align the charcoal piece with the yellow target using only two moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the piece three units per press; RIGHT moves it left, mirroring your intent. RULE: The mirror axis inverts horizontal direction, so pressing right pulls the piece toward the left edge. TRAP: Assuming standard left-to-right movement causes you to drift away from the goal, wasting turns on futile corrections.

GOAL: Align the reflection to cover the yellow target. CONTROLS: SPACE toggles focus between the piece and the axis; arrows move the selected element. RULE: The reflection mirrors the piece across the axis, so adjust both to match the target. TRAP: Assuming arrows always move the piece; ignoring the axis selection wastes turns.

GOAL: Align the gray boundary with the yellow marker on the black bar. CONTROLS: Clicking the upper blue block moves the gray edge right; clicking the lower blue block moves it left. RULE: The gray regions flow like a seesaw; pushing one side down pulls the other up, shifting the boundary by four units per click. TRAP: Believing the gray shape is static. It is a single flowing object, so changing one part inevitably moves the boundary you are trying to align.

GOAL: Guide the blue piece to the green target tile. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the piece two spaces in the chosen direction. RULE: You can only land on open or target tiles; the space you jump over must be solid ground. TRAP: Assuming you can land on solid ground to block paths wastes moves; you must aim for clear spots.

GOAL: Rotate the plug to match the socket orientation, then slide it into the pins. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; Space rotates it. RULE: The plug’s prongs must align with the socket’s gaps before insertion. TRAP: Moving before rotating caused collisions; check orientation first to avoid wasted turns.

GOAL: Slide the handle right to align with the target marker. CONTROLS: The right button shifts the handle right; the left button shifts it left. RULE: Follow the arrow direction to reach the correct alignment zone. TRAP: Assuming the handle stops due to area limits; it moves freely until aligned.

GOAL: Rotate each slot’s glyph by pressing UP until it matches the target pattern, then move left to the next slot. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selector; UP cycles the glyph; LEFT shifts focus to the previous slot. RULE: The glyph stays put when you move the selector; only the active slot changes. TRAP: Assuming DOWN is faster wastes time; stick to linear UP searches unless you know the cycle length.

GOAL: Balance five liquid columns to specific target heights. CONTROLS: Left and right buttons shift two units between adjacent columns, raising one side while lowering the other. RULE: Total volume is conserved; every transfer must keep all columns within their fixed maximum height limits. TRAP: Assuming any intermediate height is safe wastes time; exceeding a column's cap causes a failed move and resets the attempt.

GOAL: Place three blocks into their matching slots. CONTROLS: Arrows move or rotate; Space picks up or drops a block. RULE: The timer only decreases every few moves, so take your time. TRAP: Rotating to face a block does not pick it up; you must press Space again.

GOAL: Align two distinct shapes to complete a mirrored pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space cycles selection between shapes. RULE: Only the currently selected shape responds to movement; the other remains fixed. TRAP: Assuming all shapes move simultaneously or that the axis itself is a selectable piece to shift.

ESTABLISHED: The knob moves freely through gray and blue zones. It cannot exit the red piece while the red piece is horizontal. Clicking the red podium rotates the red piece. FAILED: Moving the knob to the muzzle tip and pressing right did not trigger a win. Rotating the red piece while the knob was inside it had no effect. GOAL IS NOT: Firing the knob at the podiums or simply rotating the pieces without positioning the knob correctly. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the knob one space. Clicking the red podium toggles the red piece’s orientation.

GOAL: Align all seven glyphs to match the target shapes. CONTROLS: Arrow keys navigate the menu and select the correct orientation. RULE: Only the canonical rotation counts as a match; ignore visual similarities. TRAP: Assuming any rotated version is acceptable wastes actions on false positives.

ESTABLISHED: The reference box shows a static white-top, purple-bottom pattern, not a live status. FAILED: Dipping, tilting, and pressing space at various angles failed to fill the central white triangle hole in the stack. GOAL IS NOT: Matching the reference image exactly, nor filling the entire stack uniformly. CONTROLS: Left/Right rotates the tool; Space pours paint; Up/Down does nothing; Mouse clicks on palette slots select colors.

ESTABLISHED: The player occupies a fully flooded room bounded by solid walls. Green blocks exist to the left, potentially blocking movement or acting as targets. FAILED: Assuming water levels fluctuate or that the player can pass through green blocks without consequence. GOAL IS NOT: Simply swimming to the surface or eating green blocks if they are solid obstacles. CONTROLS: LEFT/RIGHT moves the player horizontally. Mouse clicks dissolve blocks.

GOAL: Guide the knob to the yellow target by rearranging colored blocks to form a path. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the knob; clicking podiums swaps block positions. RULE: Only swapped blocks create bridges; the knob cannot pass through solid gaps. TRAP: Assuming all blocks are static wastes time; you must actively swap them to open routes.

GOAL: Align two black shapes onto hidden yellow targets using a central axis. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space cycles selection between the U-shape and the bar. RULE: Each piece must perfectly cover its corresponding yellow reflection pattern. TRAP: Assuming pieces stay separate causes tracking errors; they merge visually when overlapping, requiring white-dot tracking instead.

GOAL: Translate the bottom symbol row using phrase pairs. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; confirm sets the symbol. RULE: Group symbols to match key phrases, then output their blue equivalents. TRAP: Assuming each symbol maps individually ignores multi-symbol phrases like E-F-E.

GOAL: Reach the goal tile on the right. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the blue piece. RULE: The red guard attacks only along its facing row, not vertically. TRAP: Assuming the guard moves when you approach from below; it stays put, allowing a safe vertical approach.

GOAL: Decode the blue prompt row into the yellow answer row using a two-step chain cipher. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor to select glyphs; confirm inputs to fill the answer slots. RULE: Blue glyphs map to purple, which then map to yellow; follow the chain S→P→Y to find each target. TRAP: Assuming a direct blue-to-yellow mapping wastes time; remember the intermediate purple step is essential for decoding.

GOAL: Guide the plug to the socket by opening exactly five gates. CONTROLS: Click bars and stems to toggle gate colors; click the ball to trigger movement. RULE: The plug descends one cell for each open gate during a single sweep. TRAP: Assuming partial moves persist; if gates aren't all open, the plug bounces back instantly.

GOAL: Reach the exit in nine precise moves while navigating a grid of stationary guards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character two tiles per press, leaping over spaces. RULE: You survive only if you land on a guard from behind or the side; entering its line of sight kills you. TRAP: Assuming all adjacent guards are deadly; they are safe if you approach from their blind spots.

GOAL: Connect the green plug to its pins using the blue connector. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the selected piece; clicks selected it. RULE: Moving a piece does not drag connected pieces; each part must be moved independently. TRAP: Assuming connected pieces move together wasted time when the blue plug stayed put after green shifted.

GOAL: Guide the piece from the center dot to the blue circle at the end of the trail. CONTROLS: Click any dot within three steps of the piece to move it there instantly. RULE: The piece can only jump to dots on the visible gray path, not across empty space. TRAP: Believing you must move one dot at a time; ignoring the three-dot range doubles your clicks.

GOAL: Position the bar so its ends align with the container openings to catch the falling liquid. CONTROLS: Use arrows to slide the bar horizontally; press space to tilt and pour. RULE: Liquid pours off the bar’s ends only when those ends hover directly over the gaps in the containers below. TRAP: Assuming you can pour anywhere along the bar; tilting when ends miss the gaps wastes liquid and fails the level.

GOAL: Clear the path by removing three specific obstacles to allow water flow. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the player; clicking targeted blocks to melt them. RULE: Water drains downward through gaps, equalizing levels between connected pools. TRAP: Believing the world was static; it expands as you move, requiring new paths.

GOAL: Match the top row’s color sequence by placing dots in the correct vertical order. CONTROLS: Click a palette color to select it, then click an empty dot slot to place it. RULE: The top row acts as the strict target pattern; each dot must match its corresponding position. TRAP: Assuming any empty slot works; placing a color in the wrong vertical position fails the match.

GOAL: Position yellow and blue crosses so their lines cover all matching colored dots simultaneously. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross; Space switches between yellow and blue crosses. RULE: A dot is solved only when a cross line of the same color passes directly through its center. TRAP: Thinking dots vanish when touched; they remain until the level ends, so you must align both crosses correctly at once.

GOAL: Move two colored indicators to their target markers by adjusting panel values. CONTROLS: Clicking specific cells inside a panel increases that color’s indicator position. RULE: Only the solid inner cells of a panel register clicks; the decorative glyph pixels do not. TRAP: Clicking the colored symbol itself often fails, wasting time when you should target the blank background cells within the frame.

GOAL: Guide the diamond so its border lines cover every colored dot. CONTROLS: Space selects the next shape; arrows move the selected shape one step. RULE: A dot is solved only when a line from its matching color passes directly through it. TRAP: Assuming shapes block each other; they can overlap freely, so don’t waste moves avoiding collisions.

GOAL: Guide sliding tiles into the target circle to complete the level. CONTROLS: Click near a piece to drag it in that direction, limited by its size. RULE: Smaller pieces merge into larger ones when their paths cross, creating bigger blocks. TRAP: Assuming clicks move pieces instantly; remember you must click repeatedly to slide them step-by-step.

GOAL: Move the special piece to the far side, then use the midpoint mechanic to place a blob inside the ring. CONTROLS: Clicking empty space moves the piece. Clicking the letter swaps positions. RULE: The final placement lands at the geometric midpoint between the piece and the swapped letter. TRAP: Thinking you must click the target hole directly; instead, you must calculate the midpoint from a distant swap.

GOAL: Align the bar and two blocks to form a specific shape. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space switches selection. RULE: Only the white-highlighted piece responds to arrow inputs. TRAP: Assuming pieces stay selected after moving; you must press Space to switch between them.

GOAL: Move three separate pieces into two specific target circles to clear the level. CONTROLS: Clicking a spot moves a piece if the click is close enough, or merges two nearby pieces of the same color into one larger piece. RULE: Pieces only move or merge when your click is within a short distance of their center; otherwise, nothing happens. TRAP: Thinking clicks can move pieces from far away or that different colored pieces can merge to form a target shape.

GOAL: Insert the nib into the head. CONTROLS: Arrows move the nib; clicks commit changes. RULE: The nib shrinks to two pixels wide after each commit, allowing it to fit the thin neck. TRAP: Assuming the nib stays four pixels wide, causing you to waste moves trying to force a wide block into a narrow slot.

GOAL: Sort colored tokens into matching slots by following a hidden sequence. CONTROLS: Click two slots to swap tokens; press Space to test the current arrangement. RULE: Tokens must fill slots in a specific order, revealing one new pair per correct prefix. TRAP: Assuming colors fill all slots of one box before moving to the next, when the sequence actually interleaves boxes.

GOAL: Shrink the nib to pass the narrow neck. CONTROLS: Arrows move or rotate the nib; clicking the keypad sets its shape. RULE: The nib must fit within the three-pixel-wide gap to proceed upward. TRAP: Assuming the initial four-pixel width was permanent, causing a block at the clamps.

GOAL: Place seven colored tokens into three boxes following a specific sequence to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click palette tokens to select them, click box slots to place them, and press space to submit. RULE: The top row order dictates placement, with red tokens filling gaps between green and blue box sequences. TRAP: Assuming all boxes fill independently causes failure; red slots must interleave precisely between other colors.

ESTABLISHED: Pulling the arm left reduces its span, preventing overlap with the b-block. FAILED: Leaving the arm wide enough to reach the b-block causes unwanted collisions during vertical movement. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pushing the N-block up while the arm remains extended to the right. CONTROLS: Pulling left shortens the arm's reach; moving up pushes overlapping blocks six rows higher.

GOAL: Place seven colored pieces into a sequence of seven slots to match a hidden order. CONTROLS: Click a color to select it, then click a slot to place it. Press space to confirm the arrangement. RULE: The plug's position dictates the sequence start, placing the first box color immediately after the preceding red slots. TRAP: Ignoring the pre-filled green slot's fixed position, which uniquely determines where the plug must go.

GOAL: Position the blob centers on designated target cells without overlapping obstacles. CONTROLS: Click an anchor to select it, then click a grid cell to move it. RULE: The blob’s center is the average of its anchors; the entire shape must remain on valid terrain at every step. TRAP: Assuming direct paths work; moving one anchor can shift the center into blocked water, requiring careful ordering.

GOAL: Recolor the X to match the dots it covers. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space selects it. RULE: Shapes absorb the color of swatches they touch. TRAP: Assuming the X must return to its start to win; it only needs to cover the dots.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to align blocks with the fixed bracket. CONTROLS: Red arrow rotated the ring one way; green arrow rotated it the other. RULE: Rotation direction was counter-clockwise relative to the visual flow of blocks. TRAP: Assuming clockwise rotation wasted actions; the flow moved left along the top, not right.

ESTABLISHED: Two blocks move symmetrically; the bar is a 128-step limit, not progress. Mirrored maze arms split at the top merge. FAILED: Equalizing black maze halves (675/650 px split); vertical stacking in arms; assuming bar tracks goal distance. GOAL IS NOT: Cutting the maze into two equal halves; matching step count exactly; filling the bottom bar. CONTROLS: Input moves both blocks simultaneously in opposite directions or same direction based on symmetry; no independent control.

GOAL: Align the block's internal pattern with the target box before dropping it into the hole. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; entering the special zone rotates its pattern. RULE: Each entry into the zone rotates the pattern one step clockwise. TRAP: Moving away does not rotate the pattern; only entering triggers the change.

GOAL: Clear all crosses from the grid in eight clicks. CONTROLS: Click a cross to select it, then click a gray preview to move it there. RULE: Sliding crosses absorb any crosses they pass over, clearing multiple cells in one move. TRAP: Assuming adjacent crosses block movement; they are actually absorbed when a selected cross slides through them.

GOAL: Guide the green blob to its target while ensuring it never overlaps the static purple anchors. CONTROLS: Click to move the blob one step; drag to reposition the green anchor points. RULE: The blob’s footprint must strictly avoid all anchor zones, even if those anchors are movable. TRAP: Assuming anchors are safe zones until moved; they block paths immediately upon placement.

GOAL: Match the static widget pattern by coloring specific cells red. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to change their color. RULE: The widget shows the target; match it exactly. TRAP: Assuming clicks toggle colors; they only set to red, requiring precise initial moves.

GOAL: Match the grid to the two overlapping widget patterns. CONTROLS: Click empty cells to change their color. RULE: Each widget dictates the colors for its specific three-by-three area. TRAP: Assuming widgets are clickable; they are fixed anchors that define the target pattern.

GOAL: Move two yellow blocks to specific bracket slots using limited moves. CONTROLS: Buttons rotate rows or columns, shifting all blocks in that line cyclically. RULE: Only yellow block positions matter for the solution; other colors are distractions. TRAP: Believing all blocks must be arranged correctly; ignoring non-yellow blocks saves crucial actions.

GOAL: Move the yellow block into the left bracket and the orange block into the right bracket.
